title: Dashboard Todo Navigation Permission Consistency

items.action: open the Todo list from the Dashboard quick actions

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.todos.read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing Todo authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only Dashboard Todo navigation visibility is aligned with the existing route guard.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /todos route already requires fair_crm.todos.read; this change aligns the originating Dashboard quick action.

notes: Dashboard previously rendered the Todo'lara Git quick action for every authenticated organization user even when fair_crm.todos.read was absent. The action now fails closed in the UI and is offered only when Todo read permission is granted. Dashboard access itself remains public within the authenticated organization.
